title: Guilherme Piva and his discreet relationship with businessman father of two
seoTitle: Guilherme Piva's discreet romance with businessman
subtitle: Actor from 'Quem Ama Cuida' discusses his life as a couple and differing family routines
excerpt: Guilherme Piva, 52, opens up about his relationship with businessman Alan Grimberg, father of two, explaining how he balances professional and personal life.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Guilherme Piva, who plays Edvaldo in the soap opera "Quem Ama Cuida," made headlines by publicly confirming his relationship with businessman Alan Grimberg. The declaration of love made on Valentine's Day sparked public curiosity, eager to understand how life as a couple works when there are children and distinct routines.

The relationship between Guilherme Piva and Alan Grimberg

The couple began dating in 2025 and, according to Guilherme himself, the relationship is based on respect for their different lifestyles. The actor revealed that he prefers to maintain separate homes because Grimberg has shared custody of two children – a 9-year-old boy and a 14-year-old teenager – and his own family life.

How differing routines influence daily life

In an interview with the GENTE column's program, Guilherme explained that despite his affection for his partner's children, he preserves his personal space. “I don't feel like bringing my boyfriend home, because my boyfriend has two children, he has another life,” he stated, emphasizing that their time together occurs when both can meet without interfering with parental responsibilities.

Theater career and the choice of different projects

In addition to the soap opera, Guilherme is currently performing in the play "Visiting Mr. Green" at Teatro Vannucci in Rio. He highlights that theater provided him with the know-how that facilitated his entry into television, recalling that director Alexandre Avancini invited him to the soap opera "Xica da Silva" after seeing him in a children's production.

Impact of public life on intimacy

Even with the visibility from the soap opera, Guilherme maintains a discreet stance on his love life. He emphasizes that the relationship does not alter his work routine or Grimberg's family dynamic. The choice not to integrate their homes reflects the intention to preserve the children's stability and avoid scheduling conflicts.

Perspectives for the couple's future

Although there are no plans to live together at the moment, Guilherme expresses confidence in the continuation of the relationship. The public declaration of love and transparency about their family arrangement suggest that the couple seeks to consciously balance professional life, paternal responsibilities, and mutual affection.

With information from Extra online, VEJA.
